DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 歩く会の受付にいらしたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to register for the walking group?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申し込んだグエンです。開始が十時なのに、十五分遅れました。皆さんは出発したようですが、途中から参加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十五分遅れの申込者として途中参加可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm Nguyen; I signed up. It started at ten, but I'm fifteen minutes late. Everyone seems to have left. Can I join along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: As a registered participant who is fifteen minutes late, ask whether you can join along the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は、参加者が一緒に出発して経路を歩く予定です。途中で合流する案内はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today, the plan is for everyone to leave together and walk the route. We are not arranging for people to join partway through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中からは難しいのですね。申し込んであるので、今日は来たけれど参加できなかったと記録してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回は参加できないと理解し来訪と不参加の記録を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So joining partway through isn't possible. Since I registered, could you record that I came today but couldn't participate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you cannot participate this time and ask for your arrival and nonparticipation to be recorded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お名前を確認して、今回は不参加になったことを記録します。お一人での散歩は別にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check your name and record that you did not participate this time. You can take a walk on your own separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会の方と話すのが目的だったので、一人で歩くより次回に参加したいです。次はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交流目的なので次回に参加したいと伝え日程を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My aim was to talk with the group, so I'd rather join next time than walk alone. When is the next one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to participate next time to socialize and ask the date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次回は来月の第二日曜です。今すぐではなく、改めてお申込みいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next one is on the second Sunday of next month. You can register again later rather than right now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来月の第二日曜ですね。次回の申込みは、どこで受け付けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来月第二日曜を控え申込先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The second Sunday of next month, then. Where do I register for the next one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the second Sunday of next month and ask where to register. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの受付で、来週からお申込みいただけます。次は出発前の受付もありますので、開始の十分前を目安にお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Registration opens here next week. There is also a check-in before departure, so please aim to arrive ten minutes before the starting time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来週この受付で申し込みます。次回は開始の十分前に着けるよう予定を立てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 来週の再申込みと次回開始十分前の到着を計画する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll register here next week. I'll plan to arrive ten minutes before it starts next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Plan to register again next week and arrive ten minutes before the next start. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせくださってありがとうございます。それでは、次回のご参加をお待ちしております。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. We look forward to seeing you next time. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 定期券の日付についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the dates on your commuter pass?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買った定期券の開始日は明日です。手元にあるので、今日もそのまま通れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日開始定期を今日使えると思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The pass I bought starts tomorrow. Since I already have it, I thought I could go through with it today too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought a pass starting tomorrow could be used today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご利用期間の始まる日は、こちらに明日の日付で記載されています。今日の乗車は別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The start of its validity is shown here as tomorrow's date. Please check separately about traveling today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開始日より前だったのですね。まだ改札を通っていません。今日は同じ区間へ一回だけ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未入場で同区間今日一回希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it hasn't started yet. I haven't gone through the gate. I only want to travel that same section once today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not entered and want one journey on the same section today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日の乗車について、切符のご案内ができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can explain which ticket you need for today's journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は別の切符を買います。この区間の片道をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 定期開始前の本日は別の片道切符を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll buy a separate ticket today. One way for this section, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a separate one-way ticket for today, before your pass starts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行き先は、定期券にあるこちらの駅でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your destination this station shown on the pass?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、行き先は同じです。帰りは家族の車なので、今日は行きの一回分だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同駅行きのみで帰り家族車と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, the destination is the same. My family will drive me back, so I only need the outward journey today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you are going to the same station and returning in your family's car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の切符をこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the ticket you need here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、今日の片道切符をお願いします。定期券は明日から使うので、財布の別の所に分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の切符を購入し明日開始の定期と別に収納すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'd like today's one-way ticket, please. I'll use the pass from tomorrow, so I'll keep it in a separate part of my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy today's ticket and explain that you will keep it separate from the pass starting tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、本日の切符をご案内します。明日以降も日付をご確認ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll help you with today's ticket. Please keep checking the dates from tomorrow onward too. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様とお待ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting with your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが泣き出したので少し離れたいです。でも順番の呼出しを聞き逃したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子が泣いて移動したいが呼出しを逃したくないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child has started crying, so I'd like to move away a little, but I don't want to miss my number being called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to move because your child is crying but do not want to miss the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの端の席でしたら、呼出しが聞こえます。番号票はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can hear the calls from this seat at the end. Do you have your numbered ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十八番の票です。外へ出て泣き止むまで待つのでなく、まずこの席へ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十八票を示し外退出でなく指定席へ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's number eighteen. Rather than going outside until my child stops crying, I'll move to this seat first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show ticket eighteen and move to the indicated seat instead of going outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号の表示も、こちらから見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see the number display from here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示が見えるので安心です。この席で子どもを抱いて、番号が出るのを見て待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示が見える指定席で子を抱き番号を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm relieved that I can see it. I'll hold my child here and watch for my number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will hold your child in the indicated seat and watch the display for your number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 呼ばれた際にお困りでしたら、係へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you need help when you are called, please speak to a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どもを抱いて片手がふさがるので、書類を出す時に少し時間をいただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 片手で書類準備に時間が必要と声掛けする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: One hand will be occupied holding my child, so it would help if I could have a little extra time to get my documents out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you need time to prepare documents with only one hand free. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let the staff know that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どもとこちらで待ちます。十八番の票と書類はかばんの手前へ置き、呼ばれたら一緒に窓口へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 票書類を取りやすく用意し子と順番を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here with my child. I'll put ticket eighteen and the documents near the front of my bag and go to the counter together when called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the ticket and documents easy to reach and wait with your child for your turn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご一緒にこちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait here together. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 採尿の準備について、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble preparing the urine sample?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今は尿が出そうにありません。早く終えるために水をたくさん飲もうと思いましたが、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採尿困難で大量飲水前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't feel able to urinate right now. I thought of drinking lots of water to finish sooner, but I wanted to ask first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about difficulty providing a urine sample before drinking a large amount of water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の状況を担当へ確認します。無理に量を決めて飲まず、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your situation with the person in charge. Please wait without deciding on and forcing yourself to drink a certain amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: さっきコップ一杯だけ飲みました。まだ採れていないので、これ以上飲むかは説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: コップ一杯飲んだと伝え追加飲水は説明を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I drank just one glass a little while ago. I still haven't collected a sample, so I'll wait for instructions before drinking any more.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you drank one glass and will await instructions before drinking more. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲んだ時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell me when you drank it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十分ほど前です。採尿の容器はもらいましたが、まだ空のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十分前飲水と空容器の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: About ten minutes ago. I've received the sample container, but it's still empty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you drank ten minutes ago and the container is empty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容器は、ご自身の物としてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep your own container with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 容器の名前は私の名前です。このまま持って待ちます。待つ場所は、ここでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人名の未使用容器を保持し待つ場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name on the container is mine. I'll keep it with me while I wait. Is this the right place to wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep your unused container with your name on it and confirm where to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちください。担当から、今の状況に合わせた案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait here. The person in charge will give instructions suited to your current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。十分ほど前に一杯飲んだことと、まだ採れていないことを、担当の方にもお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機し既飲水の時刻と量および未採取を担当へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here. I'll also tell them I drank one glass about ten minutes ago and still haven't collected a sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait and tell the person in charge when and how much you drank and that no sample has been collected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へ確認します。こちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check with the person in charge. Please wait here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目撃された車について、覚えていることを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you remember about the car you witnessed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 狭い道で塀に当たった車を見ました。番号を全部覚えていませんが、後ろの二桁は二十三でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 塀接触車の番号末尾二十三のみ覚えていると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a car hit a wall on a narrow road. I don't remember the whole number, but the last two digits were twenty-three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you remember only the final digits, twenty-three, of the car that hit the wall. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読めなかった部分は、そのままお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us which parts you couldn't read, just as they were.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の二桁は木に隠れて見えませんでした。確かに読めたのは、最後の二十三だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前二桁は木で見えず推測数字を追加しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The first two digits were hidden by a tree. The only part I could definitely read was twenty-three at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that a tree hid the first two digits, without adding guessed numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車の色や形は、どのようでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: What color and shape was the car?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い小さい車でした。メーカーの印は見えていません。友人は車種を知っていると言っていますが、その点は友人に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白い小型車でメーカーは不明と答え友人の車種情報は別に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was a small white car. I couldn't see the manufacturer's emblem. My friend says they know the model, but could you check that with my friend?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe a small white car with an unknown manufacturer and ask for your friend's model information to be checked separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当たった後は、どうなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: What happened after it hit the wall?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 止まらず先へ進みました。角を右へ曲がりましたが、その後の道は見えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停止せず右折したが以後未目撃と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It continued without stopping. It turned right at the corner, but I couldn't see the road beyond that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it did not stop and turned right, but you did not see it after that. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell me the location and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この地図の道です。今日の午後一時ごろでした。読めた二十三、白い小さい車、角を右へ進んだところまでを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図場所一時ごろと確認した特徴だけまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It was this road on the map, around one this afternoon. What I can report is the twenty-three I read, a small white car, and that it turned right at the corner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Point out the location on the map, give about one o'clock, and summarize only the confirmed features. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見えた範囲を確認しました。それでは、担当が詳しく伺います。ご協力ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've established what you could see. The person in charge will ask for further details. Thank you for your cooperation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 差出し前に、何か確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you want to check before sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ箱の状態を報告するため、写真を撮っておきたいです。ここだと隣の方の宛名も写りそうなので、撮影できる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社報告用の箱写真に他客の宛名が写りそうなため撮影場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to photograph the box to report its condition to my company. Here I might capture the next person's address label, so could you tell me where I can take photos?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to photograph the box for your company because another customer's address might appear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この受付前での撮影はご遠慮ください。出口側の準備台なら、ご自身の荷物だけを撮れるように置いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please refrain from taking photos in front of this counter. At the preparation table near the exit, you can position your parcel so that only your own parcel is photographed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出口側の台ですね。箱を置いて写真を撮ったら、またこの窓口へ持って来ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出口側準備台と撮影後に窓口へ戻る手順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The table near the exit, then. After I put the box there and take photos, should I bring it back to this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the exit-side preparation table and the procedure for returning to the counter after photographing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、準備できましたらお戻りください。撮る時も、周りの方や書類が入らないようご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please return when you're ready. Also check that no people or documents nearby appear in your photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社が欲しいのは外箱の状態です。伝票の住所より、箱の角とふたが見える向きで撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社が求める外箱の状態に合わせ角とふたを撮りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The company wants to see the outer box's condition. Rather than the address on the shipping label, I'd like an angle showing the corners and lid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to photograph the corners and lid to show the outer box's condition as the company requires. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 報告に必要な範囲は、会社のご案内もご確認ください。荷物はまだ、お客様のお手元の物として扱っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check your company's instructions about what needs to be included in the report. The parcel is still considered to be in your possession at this stage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社のメモにも、外箱の状態とあります。宛名は写真に入れず、閉じたふたと四つの角を撮って見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社の指示メモを確認し宛名を写さず箱の角と閉じたふたを撮って見直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The company's note also says the condition of the outer box. I'll leave the address out and photograph the closed lid and all four corners, then review the photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the company's note, and explain that you will photograph and review the closed lid and corners without including the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真の準備の後、お荷物を窓口へお出しください。引受けの控えは、発送のお手続きでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once your photos are ready, please bring the parcel to the counter. We'll explain the acceptance receipt during the shipping procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真は箱の状態を伝えるために使い、発送の控えは受付の後に受け取ります。まず準備台へ行って、撮り終わったら箱を持って戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱状態の写真と発送受付後の控えを分け準備台で撮影後に荷物を持って戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll use the photos to show the box's condition and receive the shipping receipt after acceptance. I'll go to the preparation table first and bring the box back when I've finished photographing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the box-condition photos from the receipt after shipping acceptance, and explain that you will return with the parcel after photographing it at the preparation table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、出口側の準備台へどうぞ。周囲にお気をつけてご準備ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please use the preparation table near the exit. Please take care of those around you while preparing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与のお受け取りについて、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about receiving your salary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい会社へ移りました。口座の名義も、前の会社の名前から新しい会社の名前へ変えるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転職で会社名へ口座名義変更するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved to a new company. Do I also change the account holder's name from my old company's name to the new company's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether changing jobs requires changing the account holder's name to the new company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、通帳の名義をご確認ください。この口座の名義はお客様のお名前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please check the name in your passbook. This account is in your own name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の名前でした。給料をもらう会社の口座だと思っていましたが、会社の名前が名義になっていたのではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳本人名を読み勤務先名義ではなかったと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is my name. I thought of it as the account of the company paying my salary, but the account holder wasn't the company's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read your own name in the passbook and understand that the account was not in your employer's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先へ出す口座情報と、口座の名義は分けてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish between the account information you submit to your employer and the account holder's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい会社の用紙には、銀行名、支店、口座番号、名義の欄があります。名義には、この通帳の自分の名前を書けばよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先の提出用紙の四項目を示し名義には本人名を書くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The new company's form has fields for bank name, branch, account number, and account holder. So in the account holder field I should write my own name as shown in this passbook?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: List the four fields on your employer's form and confirm that the account holder field should contain your own name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会社の提出用紙も、ご自身でご確認ください。こちらの情報が載ったページをお示しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the company's form yourself. We can show you the page containing that information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このページを見て写します。支店名と番号はどちらもここに載っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通帳の情報ページから支店名と口座番号を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll copy from this page. Both the branch name and the number are shown here, aren't they?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the branch name and account number against the information page in the passbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらに載っています。会社の用紙を見ながら、一項目ずつお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, they're here. Please check each item against the company's form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。本人名義の口座情報を会社の用紙と照らします。会社の名前へ書き換える手続きではなく、必要な情報を確認したいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人名義を会社用紙と照合し名義改変ではないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll compare my personal account details with the company's form. I'll explain that I want to check the necessary information, rather than arrange to change the account to the company's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare your own account details with the company's form and explain that this is not a change of account holder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、通帳の記載をご確認ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check the entries in your passbook. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値段の表示で、分かりにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is any part of the price display unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このパンにシールが二枚重なっています。見える二割引きに、下の一割引きも足してよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重なった二割と一割の値引きを加算できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This bread has two overlapping stickers. Can I add the ten percent discount underneath to the twenty percent discount I can see?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the overlapping twenty percent and ten percent discounts can be added together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の価格はこちらのシールでご案内しています。二つを足して三割引きにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This sticker shows the current price. We don't add the two to make a thirty percent discount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上の二割引きだけなのですね。下の端が見えたので、両方使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上二割のみと確認し誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So only the twenty percent on top applies. I saw the edge of the lower sticker and thought both could be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that only the top twenty percent applies and explain the misunderstanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会計の価格が分かるよう、こちらで表示を整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll tidy up the display so that the checkout price is clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示を整えていただけると助かります。上の二割引きで、この一つを買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職員に表示整理を頼み上の二割引きで購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: That would help. I'd like to buy this one with the top twenty percent discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to clarify the display and say you want to buy it with the top twenty percent discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの商品でお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is this the item you mean?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この食パン一つです。レジへ持って行く前に、この商品の表示を確認したかったのです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象の食パン一つを特定しレジ前に表示を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, this one loaf of sliced bread. I wanted to confirm its price display before taking it to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the single loaf of sliced bread and explain that you want to confirm its display before checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計でも、ご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check at checkout as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この商品の表示が分かりました。割引を足さず、この一つの価格を会計で確かめて買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 加算せず対象価格を会計確認して購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the display now. I won't add the discounts; I'll check this item's price at checkout and buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy after checking the item's checkout price without adding the discounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、レジへどうぞ。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please proceed to the checkout. Thank you for checking. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: リードが通路を横切っています。少し短く持っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The leash is crossing the path. Could you hold it a little shorter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。犬が反対側の木へ行ったので、私との間のひもが人の通る所をふさいでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬との間のリードが横断して通路をふさいだと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. My dog went to the tree on the other side, and the leash between us was blocking where people walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the leash between you and your dog crosses and blocks the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 犬と同じ側へ寄り、通路を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please move to the same side as your dog and clear the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらへ寄りました。犬を強く引いて戻すのでなく、近づいてひもを短く持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同側へ移り犬を引かず近づいて短く持つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've moved over here. Instead of pulling the dog back hard, I'll move closer and hold the leash short.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move to the same side, approach the dog without pulling it, and shorten the leash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかの方が通る時も、足元のひもにお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also watch the leash near people's feet when others pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。散歩の途中で携帯を見て、犬だけ先へ行かせていました。携帯をしまってから歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯をしまい犬だけ先行させない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I was looking at my phone during the walk and letting the dog go ahead on its own. I'll put my phone away before walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put your phone away and do not let the dog go ahead on its own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 立ち止まる時は、通路の端でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you stop, please stay at the edge of the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水を飲ませる時は、ここより広い端へ寄ります。リードも体の近くで持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 犬の飲水時は広い端へ移りリードを体の近くで保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I give the dog water, I'll move to a wider spot at the edge. I'll also hold the leash close to my body.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move to a wider edge when giving the dog water and keep the leash close to your body. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 水を飲ませる時も、ひもが通路を横切らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make sure the leash doesn't cross the path when you give the dog water too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 犬と同じ側で短く持ち直しました。次に人が来たら、ひもも含めて通れる幅を空けて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短く持ち直し人の通行幅をひも含め空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've adjusted it and am holding it short on the same side as the dog. When someone comes, I'll leave enough room to pass, including keeping the leash clear, and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Adjust the leash to a short length and leave room for people to pass, keeping the leash clear too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通路を空けていただき、ありがとうございます。それでは、犬と一緒に散歩をお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23237-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for clearing the path. Enjoy your walk with your dog. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは駅の案内です。ご用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is station information. How can I help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長久手古戦場駅にいます。車いすを使っているので、乗る時の案内を受けたいです。この通話で相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長久手古戦場駅の通話で車いす乗車の相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm at Nagakute Kosenjo Station. I use a wheelchair and would like guidance when boarding. Can I discuss it on this call?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about wheelchair boarding assistance through the call at Nagakute Kosenjo Station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご相談を伺います。今、インターホンのある場所でお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can take your request. Are you waiting where the intercom is now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。まだホームへ進んでいません。友人と二人ですが、段差の所を友人だけに任せるのは不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ホーム未進入で友人だけの段差補助に不安と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I haven't gone to the platform yet. I'm with a friend, but I'm worried about relying only on my friend to help at the step.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not entered the platform and are worried about your friend handling the step alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お手伝いの方法を確認します。行き先の駅名をおっしゃっていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check how we can help. Could you tell me your destination station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 藤が丘駅です。急いで乗らなくてもよいので、案内を受けてからホームへ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 藤が丘駅を行き先として伝え案内後のホーム移動を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Fujigaoka Station. I don't need to board in a hurry, so I'd like to go to the platform after receiving guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give Fujigaoka as your destination and say you want to move to the platform after guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内の方法を確認しますので、今の場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the arrangements for guidance, so please wait where you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。駅員さんを探していたのですが、このインターホンで相談すればよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: インターホンで相談し現在位置に待機すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here. I was looking for a station employee, but I can ask for advice on this intercom, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will consult through the intercom and remain where you are. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。この通話で伺っています。確認の間、お連れの方も同じ場所でお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I'm taking your request on this call. Could your companion also wait in the same place while I check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人も隣にいます。二人でここに待っていますので、乗る時のお手伝いについて確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人も同じ場所に待つと伝え乗車補助の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend is beside me too. We'll both wait here, so please check about assistance when boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend will wait in the same place and request confirmation of boarding assistance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。係員へ確認しますので、いったん通話を終えてこちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check with the staff, so please end the call for now and wait here. Goodbye.
